title: eupatorium iltisii
intro: Eupatorium iltisii, commonly known as Illinois boneset, is a plant species in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of colds and flu. The therapeutic actions of Illinois boneset are attributed to its ability to reduce fever, relieve muscle and joint pain, and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Eupatorium iltisii include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
